title: Member Billing Basis — The Level Payment Plan on a Refined Fuels and Propane Account
content:
A level payment plan on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts spreads an estimated year of fuel over equal monthly instalments so the member is not billed the whole winter in January.

**The plan year.** It begins on the programme's start date, runs for the programme's number of months, and is trued up on the programme's reconciliation date.

**The estimate.** It is the member's gallons over the twelve months ending the month before enrolment, priced at the posted price on the day of enrolment, less any down payment the programme requires.

**Billing and collection.** Instalments are billed on the same day each month and are collected by draft where the member has authorised one.

**What the plan does not do.** Fuel delivered is still billed at the price of the day and posted to the account, so the instalments pay down the balance rather than replacing the billing; the plan is a payment arrangement and not a fixed price.

**At reconciliation.** The clause formerly stated here — "At reconciliation a member who has underpaid is billed the difference in one sum and a member who has overpaid is credited it, and the credit stands against next year's instalments rather than being refunded." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which the true-up at the close of a plan year is arrived at and disposed of.

**Leaving the plan.** A member who leaves the plan part way through the year is billed the whole outstanding balance at once, because the smoothing ends with the plan.

## The estimate, taken apart

| Element | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| The gallons | The member's gallons over the twelve months ending the month before enrolment |
| The price put on them | The posted price on the day of enrolment |
| The deduction | Any down payment the programme requires |
| What the result is used for | The sum spread over the programme's instalments |

*Hypothetical.* A member enrolling in a month whose preceding twelve months carried 1200.0 gallons has those gallons priced at the posted price standing on the day of enrolment. The down payment the programme requires comes off the resulting figure, and what is left is what the programme's instalments spread.

**A member asks whether the plan fixes the price of the fuel.** It does not. The plan is a payment arrangement; fuel is still billed at the price of the day and posted to the account.
